testsuite.name: workshop.vfx.math.core.JomlOracleTest

testcase.name: Records which application order JOML's rotationXYZ uses; it must match one of the two candidates
Quat.rotate agrees with JOML Quaterniond on 10,000 seeded rotations
Quat.slerp agrees with JOML slerp (as rotations) away from the near-parallel regime
Quat.mul agrees with JOML's Hamilton product (same operand order)

testsuite.system-out: [M1 JOML report] rotationXYZ applies X first = false, applies Z first = true
